package.name: omx_vla_app
package.description:
What "pick the cube" means, in one place: the task config, the closed-form kinematics, the MoveIt wrapper and the cube-pose sampler.
A library, not a program. Four executables in three incompatible Python environments read it -- isaac/build_scene.py under Isaac's 3.11, the expert and recorder under the control container, ml/convert.py and ml/eval.py under the ML container -- so it holds nothing heavier than PyYAML and numpy, and imports rclpy nowhere.
⚠️ moveit_ik.py is the exception: it needs the control container. See its docstring for why it cannot be used from the ML side.
